       SUM(d.units_sold) as total_units, SUM(d.revenue_inr) as total_revenue,
       (SUM(d.revenue_inr) - SUM(d.units_sold)*p.cost_inr) as gross_profit
FROM store.daily_sales d
JOIN store.products p ON d.sku = p.sku
WHERE d.date >= '2026-06-01' AND d.date <= '2026-06-30'
GROUP BY p.sku, p.name, p.cost_inr, p.price_inr, p.case_units
ORDER BY total_units ASC;
